tags.label: Route visit
tags.description: Counts one render of a canonical, content-free route key.
tags.trigger: A consented foreground session renders a route.

tags.label: Completed movement or outcome
tags.description: Counts a rendered route transition when fromRoute is present, or an explicit successful product outcome when outcomeId is present.
tags.trigger: A destination renders after a different route, or product code records an enumerated success.

tags.label: Failed outcome
tags.description: Increments the route and outcome failure counters without accepting error text or user content.
tags.trigger: Product code records an explicit failure using an allowlisted-style outcomeId.

tags.label: Performance measurement
tags.description: Adds one bounded, 10-millisecond-coarsened page-load or named-action duration to aggregate latency histograms.
tags.trigger: A route paints its second frame or an enumerated product action finishes.

tags.label: Live activity heartbeat
tags.description: Refreshes ephemeral active-session state so routes and transitions can pulse in the map; it does not add a route visit.
tags.trigger: Every 20 seconds while analytics is enabled and the app remains active.

tags.label: Session path close
tags.description: Stores the run-collapsed anonymous route path for aggregate path counts and removes the session from live activity.
tags.trigger: The app leaves the foreground or the active flow session ends.

tags.label: Event ID
tags.description: A random UUID used to make ingestion idempotent; receipts expire after seven days.
tags.trigger: Generated once for every queued analytics event.

tags.label: Foreground session ID
tags.description: Connects events within one foreground journey. The server hashes it before storage.
tags.trigger: Created at the first route visit and replaced after 90 seconds of inactivity.

tags.label: Occurrence time
tags.description: ISO timestamp used to place aggregate counters into the correct UTC day and reject stale or future payloads.
tags.trigger: Stamped when the event is created on the device.

tags.label: Lifecycle type
tags.description: Selects one of the five documented lifecycle behaviors in this catalog.
tags.trigger: Included on every event.

tags.label: Canonical route
tags.description: The rendered Expo route after groups, query strings, IDs, invite codes, emails, and authored values are removed.
tags.trigger: Included on every event, for example /travel/[id]/tools.

tags.label: Previous canonical route
tags.description: Identifies the source side of a completed or live route-to-route transition.
tags.trigger: Added when the session moved from a different route.

tags.label: Enumerated outcome
tags.description: A stable product-defined success or failure key such as plants.watering; free-text errors are rejected.
tags.trigger: Added only when product code explicitly records a complete or fail outcome.

tags.label: Anonymous session path
tags.description: A run-collapsed list capped at 30 canonical routes and released by the map only after at least three matching executions.
tags.trigger: Added to the session-end event.

tags.label: Performance metric
tags.description: Selects the fixed page-load or action timing category; arbitrary metric names are rejected.
tags.trigger: Added only to a performance measurement event.

tags.label: Coarsened duration
tags.description: A non-negative duration rounded to 10 milliseconds and capped at 120 seconds; only aggregate histograms persist.
tags.trigger: Added only to a validated performance measurement event.

tags.label: Contract version
tags.description: Pins the upload to the validated FlowEventBatchV1 wire contract.
tags.trigger: Included on every upload batch.

tags.label: Opaque install ID
tags.description: Supports idempotency, rate limits, and a stable anonymous device label. The API immediately HMACs it and never persists the raw value or displays it.
tags.trigger: Included server-side only when Usage Analytics consent is enabled.

tags.label: Platform
tags.description: Separates aggregate evidence for iOS, Android, web, or unknown clients.
tags.trigger: Resolved for every upload batch.

tags.label: Release environment
tags.description: Separates production from TestFlight, preview, and development traffic so product totals stay clean.
tags.trigger: Resolved from the running build for every upload batch.

tags.label: App version
tags.description: Groups counters by shipped app version for rollout and regression comparisons.
tags.trigger: Resolved from application metadata for every upload batch.

tags.label: Event collection
tags.description: Contains up to 50 validated flow events; content fields and oversized batches are rejected.
tags.trigger: Built when pending consented events are flushed.
